描述_ZN: Blue Zhang velvet doughnut eight-piece lapel coat, late Qing dynasty, body length 77 cm, both sleeves through length 164 cm, cuff width 39 cm, hem width 90 cm, front and back train length 17 cm, left and right train length 14 cm. Qing Palace old collection.　　Horse coat standing collar, right overlapping, flat sleeve end, train four open. This coat fabric for Zhang velvet, velvet flower, eight treasure group flower pattern. Garment edge with the same color and texture ice plum pattern wide edge, outside and set the narrow edge of plain green satin. The coat is lined with moon white plain spun silk. The inside of the collar is inlaid with gray rat skin. The lapel is decorated with one copper and gold plated burin button and four burin heron bird pattern flat buttons.　　This is the Qing Dynasty casual wear. The coat pattern is clear, rich in relief, cut pile rule flush, pile circle ground uniform fine.
